findings: All 192 silhouettes reviewed at four sizes on black-on-white sheets. Heavy strokes, controlled corners and separated structural families are consistent across the catalog.
Corrected apertures remain open at small sizes; no blank glyphs or lost components/counters in the bound size audit.
1-3-pixel extra enclosed specks remain in nine glyphs at 16px and two at 64px; none at 32px or 128px. These do not obstruct the reviewed silhouettes.
Numeric shape matching and visual review do not establish legal originality or exact equivalence to the reference artwork.

raster_sensitivity_policy: Reported explicitly; anti-alias distribution is not a geometry-style gate.

distinctness.method: tight crop; longest dimension uniform-scaled; centered; bounded translation; x/y reflections

acceptance_rationale: Complete catalog, declared family quotas, every profile shape median within its reference IQR, at least 80% in each reference P10–P90 band, topology frequencies within 10 percentage points, stable threshold topology, distinct silhouettes, and separate optical review. Numeric acceptance does not assert an exact style match or establish originality.
